name: Imazu 13 -- head-on + crossing from port (3 targets)
own_ship_role: mutual (both alter to starboard) to ts1 / stand-on to ts2 / stand-on to ts3
description: Canonical Imazu problem 13 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/13/13.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 approaches head-on; ts2 crosses from port (abeam); ts3 crosses from port (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship alters course to starboard (not port) for the head-on target(s).
Own-ship holds course/speed as stand-on for the target(s) crossing from port, only acting under Rule 17(b) if the other vessel clearly fails to act.
Own-ship's manoeuvre for one target does not create a new close-quarters situation with another (Rule 8(d)).
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
